label: reported

reported.how: Sum of price fields in Daytona's billed usage periods.

excluded: no per-sandbox creation fee, egress charge or plan fee is listed on the pricing page (absence of a listing, not a statement that none exist); network limits are applied by billing tier
snapshots made from a sandbox remain billed for storage; the snapshot storage rate is not published

which plan the rates need: none. The pricing page lists one set of rates and no tier-specific rates; Tier 1 (email verified) allows sandboxes up to the 4 vCPU / 8 GiB per-sandbox maximum, but its organization pool is 10 vCPU and 10 GiB of RAM in one table (20 GiB in another), so one such sandbox fits, and a second only if the 20 GiB figure is the right one.
not priced here: Windows (the pricing page lists "OS Windows $0.0858/vCPU/h"). GPU sandboxes are priced per GPU model in each class.

Plan allowance: $200 in free compute, no credit card for the trial (free credits do not cover GPU sandboxes); Tier 1 (email verified) limits the whole organization to 10 vCPU and 30 GiB storage (RAM 10 or 20 GiB, see open_questions); Tier 2 (card + $25 top-up) 100 vCPU; Tier 3 ($500) 250 vCPU; Tier 4 ($2,000 every 30 days) 500 vCPU; startups: up to $50k credits
